Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATC (ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS) FOR BIDDING Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) 1. Mandatory Installation, Commissioning and Comprehensive On-Site Service Support in Kerala The bidder, irrespective of their geographical location, shall ensure the availabili ty of qualified and experienced technical personnel at the purchaser's institution in Kerala for the proper installation, commissioning, calibration, testing and successful demonstration of the instrument. The bidder shall take full responsibility for providing prompt and reliable on-site technical s upport and after-sales service throughout the warranty period, withou t citing geographical distance or location as a reason for delay or non- availability of service. The bidder shall ensure that a qualified service engine er is available to attend service complaints within 48 hours and arrange an on- site visit within a maximum of 5 working days from receipt of the complaint, wh erever required. The bidder shall submit a written undertaking confirming their ability and comm itment to provide all the above services at the installation site in Kerala, irrespe ctive of their registered office or service centre location. Failure to provide the s tipulated installation, training or service support shall be treated as non-complia nce with the contractual obligations. 2. Availability of Dedicated Service Personnel The bidder shall nominate a dedicated technical service representative responsi ble for coordinating installation, maintenance and service-related activities at th e purchaser's institution in Kerala. The contact details of the designated represe ntative shall be furnished along with the bid. 3. Availability of Essential Spare Parts The bidder shall ensure the availability of essential spare parts, accessories and consumables required for the proper functioning of the instrument throughout t he warranty period. Any delay in obtaining spare parts from outside the state s hall not be considered a valid reason for prolonged service interruption.

4. Software Updates and technical Assistance (if any) The bidder shall provide necessary software updates, firmware upgrades, bug fi xes and technical assistance required for the effective functioning of the instru ment during the warranty period, without additional charges. 5. Calibration and Performance Verification The bidder shall ensure proper calibration and performance verification of the in strument at the time of installation. Relevant calibration and performance verifi cation reports shall be provided to the purchaser. 6. Warranty and Comprehensive Technical Support The bidder shall provide comprehensive warranty support covering manufacturi ng defects, component failures and technical malfunctions under normal operat ing conditions. All applicable repair and replacement activities shall be carried o ut without additional financial liability to the purchaser during the warranty peri od. 7. Service documentation and Maintenance records The bidder shall maintain and provide proper documentation of installation, co mmissioning, calibration, preventive maintenance, breakdown visits and compo nent replacements. Copies of relevant service reports shall be submitted to the purchaser. 8. No Additional Travel or Logistics Charges The bidder shall not claim any additional charges towards travel, accommodatio n, transportation or logistics for installation, commissioning, warranty-related se rvice visits and technical support at the purchaser's institution in Kerala.

9. Commitment for Continued Service Support The bidder shall ensure the availability of technical assistance and essential spa re parts even after the expiry of the warranty period, on a chargeable basis as mutually agreed, subject to availability and applicable contractual terms. . 3.
